title: CmdPal: More button is visible when there's not enough commands

judgment.rationale: The reporter is the assigned maintainer and open PR 49769 directly changes More visibility to require true overflow.
evidence: Maintainer discussion defines More as overflow-only after dedicated primary and secondary commands.
PR 49769 hides More for a single secondary command while preserving context menus and key bindings.
judgment.recommended_action: Track the maintainer-owned PR rather than create a competing design.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR 49769 is an open non-draft, maintainer-authored implementation of the reported behavior.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette exposes More despite only having the dedicated primary and secondary commands; the maintainer has an open matching fix.
known_information: The issue is assigned to its maintainer.
The stated intended design is overflow-only More visibility.
PR 49769 includes regression tests and preserves context-menu behavior.
inferences: No additional Command Palette work should begin unless the PR reveals an uncovered overflow case.
issue_context.analysis: Ownership and implementation are already established by the issue author and matching PR.
initial_investigation: Read the issue discussion and PR 49769 summary and commit details.

information_gaps.why_needed: The behavior is handled in an unmerged implementation.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Verify the PR's single-secondary and overflow test cases during review.
